name: gather_backward
description: Backward of gather: accumulates grad into the input shape using index along dim. Repeated indices accumulate their gradients. The callable contract is (grad, self, dim, index, sparse_grad); original pytest owns supported overloads, errors, dtype, shape and mutation assertions. The current original correctness and benchmark suites exercise sparse_grad=False; this does not redefine the public sparse_grad argument or claim coverage of sparse output. Inputs are not mutated and the result is newly allocated.
